template: Compare each object with the shadow it casts on the ground: say from which general direction the light is coming, and whether it sits high in the sky or low near the horizon. State your conclusion, justify it by describing the direction the shadows fall and how their length compares with the height of the objects casting them, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

light_direction.visual_signal: rendered shadow direction opposite the light
light_direction.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

light_height.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery
